cases.description: listed ids without a value are left out
non-ASCII text is hashed as UTF-8
quotes, backslashes and controls are escaped like canonical JSON
a source with no counted properties
keys are ordered by bytes, not numerically
keys with accents and astral characters are ordered by UTF-8 bytes
U+2028, U+2029, DEL and U+0085 are written as they are
control characters use lower-case \u escapes and the short forms
empty arrays and objects keep their type
